name: RemixAvatar — Start with a Clear Photo
tagline: Start with a clear front-facing photo, then pick a style and sign in.
description: RemixAvatar generates a profile picture from a photo you upload and a style reference you choose. Use a natural, front-facing photo where your face is easy to recognize, pick a look or upload a reference, then sign in. Generation is estimated at 15–30 seconds; detailed styles may take longer. Eligible new accounts get 1 free creation with no card required. One-time packs start at $2.99 for 10 creations, and there is no subscription.
